origine_fr: La terre 土 et 曾, écrit 丷, 口, 丨 et 日. On ajoute de la terre : augmenter, accroître. 曾 donne le son : zēng, comme 增.
origine_en: Earth 土 and 曾, written 丷, 口, 丨 and 日. Earth is added on: to increase, to add to. 曾 gives the sound: zēng, like 增.

phrase.en: The number of students has gone up.
